title.narrative: Increasing Access to Sexual and Reproductive Health Commodities and Services through the Private Sector Channels - ACTUATE

description.narrative: ACTUATE is a four-year project running from (July 2021 – June 2025), funded by the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands Uganda (EKN) worth US$ 5.9 million, this funding with an additional US$ 4 million investment from DKT International will account for a total combined investment of US$ 10 million in the next four years. This Investment is towards advancing access to sexual reproductive health commodities and services in Uganda through the private sector channels

Goal To increase uptake of sexual-reproductive health commodities and services through private sector channels. Objectives 1-To Increase equitable access to SRH commodities and services through the private sector 2-To Increase Collaboration between Public and Private Sector 3-To Increase empowerment of women and girls (in the product and service delivery supply chain)

department.narrative: DKT Kenya, Uganda and South Sudan (regional office)

organisation.narrative: DKT International is one of the largest providers of contraception and safe abortion products, services, and technology in the world. Every day in more than 90 countries, DKT teams, and programs work to ensure that women and men are able to exercise their fundamental human rights by determining when, if and how they choose to have children.
